simple.meaning: כַּף (kaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 195 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 8:9. The surrounding contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּף (H3709) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: כַּף (kaph) / H3709 is traced through Genesis 8:9, Genesis 20:5, Genesis 31:42, Genesis 32:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
definitions.usage: branch, foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
definitions.full: H3709. kaph כַּף 192 noun feminine 1Kin 8:54 hollow, or flat of the hand, palm, sole of foot, pan (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic id. , Assyrian kappu, hand, pan, kippatu, hollow; Arabic palm, hand ) — absolute ׳כ Job 29:9 +, so read probably also Ezek 29:7 b for כָּתֵף ᵑ0 ( ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Sm Co, compare v a ); כָּ֑ף 2Kin 11:12 +; more often construct כַּף Gen 40:11 +; suffix כַּמִּי Judg 12:3 , כַּמְּךָ Job 13:31, etc.; in Ezek 29:7 read כַּף Qr for כפך Kt (so Ew Hi Sm Co Da); dual כַּמַּיִם Isa 49:16 +; construct כַּמֵּי Exod 29:24 (twice in verse) + 3t.; suffix כַּמַּי Gen 20:5 +, כַּמָּיו Num 24:10 +, כַּמֵּיהֶם Isa 59:6 2 t., כַּמֵּימוֺ Job 27:23 , etc.; plural כַּמּוֺת (especially of soles , and in metaphor senses) absolute Num 4:7 +; construct 2Kin 9:35 +, suffix כַּפֹתָיו Exod 25:29 ; 37:16 ; — 1. a. of human beings , hollow or flat of hand, palm , (c. 116 t.) 2Kin 4:34 (twice in verse); פ עַלכּכַּף הַכּוס אֵת ׳נָתַן Gen 40:11 , 21 (E), set the cup upon the palm of Pharaoh (compare 40:11 a בְּיָדִי מַּרְעֹה וְכוֺס ), similarly Lev 8:27 (twice in verse) (P) +; עַלכּכַּמּוֺ אֲשֶׁר הַשֶּׁמֶן 14:16-17 , 18 , 27 , 28 ; as distinguished from wrist and arm, Deut 25:12 ; rarely with ידים (always כַּכּוֺת ), ידיו כַּמּוֺת שְׁתֵּי 1Sam 5:4 (of Dagon), ׳כ הַיָּדַיִם 2Kin 9:35 , compare Dan 10:10 ; הַשְּׂמָאלִית כַּף Lev 14:15 , 26 ; note especially כ ׳מְלֹא קֶמַח 1Kin 17:12 a handful of meal (literally palmful ), compare Eccl 4:6 (where distinguished from חָפְנַיִם מלא a double fistful ; in both these passages of a very small quantity); compare מִן כַּמּוֺ וַיְמַלֵּא Lev 9:17 (reference to קֻמְצוֺ מְלֹא 2:2 ; 5:12 ; compare 6:8 ). In Exod 4:4 (JE), Prov 31:19 ; Ezek 21:16 ; Psa 129:7 , etc., the thought is that of grasping. b. anthropomorph. of ׳י covering Moses over with his palm, עָלֶיךָ כַמִּי וְשַׂכֹּתִי Exod 33:22 (J), and so figurative (with שׁית ) Psa 139:5 ; withdrawing הֵסִירׅ ( his hand Exod 33:23 (J); removing ׅ הִרְהִּיק ( his afficting hand Job 13:21 ; אוֺר כִּסָּה עַלכּכַּמַּיִם 36:32 , i.e. he (God) hath filled his palms with light. c. once of animals , עַלכּכַּמָּיו הוֺלֵךְ Lev 11:27 going upon their palms , i.e. paws (cats, dogs, etc.). d. phrases are: — (I) כַּף הִכָּה = clap the hands , in applause 2Kin 11:12 so כ ׳תָּקַע Psa 47:2 , כ ׳מָחָא Isa 55:12 (figurative of trees), Psa 98:8 (figurative of rivers); but especially in scorn, contempt, etc., אֶתכַּֿמָּיו סָפַק Num 24:10 (J), כַמֵּ֑ימוֺ עָלֵימוֺ יִשְׂמֹּק Job 27:23 ; so עלֿ כַּף תָּקַע Nahum 3:19 , אֶלֿ כַמִּי הִכָּה Ezek 22:13 (of ׳י ); absolute, בְכַמְּךָהִכָּה 6:11 (as יד מחא 25:6 ), אֶלכַּֿף כַּף הִכָּה 21:19 , אֶלכַּֿמִּי כַמִּי אַכֶּה 21:22 (of ׳י ). (2) בַּכַּף תָּפַשׂ grasp, seize with the hand 29:7 compare 29:7 (on text see above) (3) of hand-grasp as pledge כַּמֶּיךָתָּקַעְתָּ לַזָּר Prov 6:1 ( if ) thou hast smitten thy palms (given a double hand-grasp), for another (so De; || לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ עָרַבְתָּ ); so absolute כף תקע 17:18 ; 22:26 (compare ליד תקע Job 17:3 ). (4) often of hand spread out in prayer, as sign of longing to receive, with אֶלֿ מָּרַשׂ Exod 9:29 , 33 (J), 1Kin 8:38 2Chr 6:29 , etc. (see יד Psa 143:6 ; Lam 1:17 and יָד 1d , above; also שׁטח נשׂא, פרשׂ, ). (5) לְפֶה כַּף שׂים , in respectful silence, Job 29:9 . (6) figurative נַפְשִׁי בְכַמִּיוָאָשִׂימָה Judg 12:3 = I have taken my life in my hand (i.e. hazarded it), so 1Sam 19:5 ; 28:21 ; Job 13:14 and (without verb) Psa 119:109 . (7) כ ׳נִקְיֹן Gen 20:5 cleanness of palms is figurative for purity of act, compare Psa 26:6 , also Job 9:30 ; 22:30 ; Psa 24:4 ; 73:13 ; conversely, בְּכַמָּ֑י חָמָס ) לֹא ( Job 16:17 ; 1Chr 12:18 ; Isa 59:6 ; Jonah 3:8 , compare Isa 59:3 (so ידים 1:15 ), Job 31:7 ; Psa 7:4 . — In many cases כַּף is not to be distinguished from יָד ; so in phrase כ ׳יְגִיעַ toil of the hands Gen 31:42 ; Hag 1:11 ; Job 10:3 ; Psa 128:2 ; כ ׳מֹּעַל 9:17 , כ ׳חֵפֶץ Prov 31:13 ; כ ׳תְּבוּנוֺת Psa 78:72 , כ ׳מְּרִי Prov 31:16 ; compare Micah 7:3 . 2 = power (i.e. grasp) of any one, בכף נתן Judg 6:13 = deliver into the power of , so Jer 12:7 , compare בכף בּוֺא Prov 6:3 ; usually הִצִּיל מּדָה, הוֺשִׁיעַ, etc., with מִכַּף = out of the power of Judg 6:14 ; 1Sam 4:3 ; 2Sam 14:16 ; 19:10 (twice in verse); 22:1 (twice in verse) = Psa 18:1 (title), 2Kin 16:7 (twice in verse); 20:6 = Isa 38:6 ; Micah 4:10 ; Jer 15:21 ; 2Chr 30:6 ; 32:11 ; Ezra 8:31 ; Psa 71:4 (compare יָד 5g , p. 391 above) 3 רַגְלָהּכַּף , etc., = sole of foot , Gen 8:9 (J), Josh 3:13 ; 4:18 (both J E), 1Kin 5:17 ; 2Kin 19:24 = Isa 37:25 ; Deut 11:24 ; 28:56 , 65 ; Josh 1:3 (D) Ezek 43:7 ; Malachi 3:21; וְעַד רַגְלוֺ קָדְקֳדוֺמִכַּף 2Sam 14:25 ; Job 2:7 , compare Isa 1:6 (figurative); כ ׳מִדְרַךְ ׳ר Deut 2:5 treading-place for the sole of a foot ; of the cherubim Ezek 1:7 , of a calf, (in simile) 1:7 ., (according to MT; compare however Co). 4 of various hollow, bending or bent objects: — a. hollow (i.e. socket), of the thigh -joint, ׳כ יָרֵךְ b. pan, vessel (as hollow), used in ritual, Exod 25:29 ; 37:16 ; Num 5:7 ; 7:14-15 t. Numbers 7; 1Kin 7:50 2Chr 4:22 ; 2Kin 25:14 = Jer 52:18-19 , 2Chr 24:14 . c. hollow of sling, 1Sam 25:29 . d. תְּמָרִים כַּמּוֺת Lev 23:40 +? hand-shaped branches (or fronds ) of palm-trees. e. הַמַּנְעוּל כַּמּוֺת Song 5:5 the (bent) handles of the bolt.
